label: early original-phase first l/c/2/q/3/o-class token in sequences starting with j/f/g/u/r/0/b
explanation: Fires almost exclusively (99.8% of mass) in the original input phase at positions t=2-5 (peak t=3, 53% of mass; never at t=0,1 or t>=7, essentially never in delimiter/copy phase). The current input must be one of a token class led by l and c (then 2, q, 3, o, w, k, v), usually its first occurrence of such a token, and it is strongly modulated by which tokens came earlier, especially the first token: j, f, g, u, r, 0, b (also h, i) give 3-4x lift. Strongest activations are l or c at t=3-4 after a prefix such as 'f 0 0', 'f g 0', 'j g h'. It behaves like a graded sum of (early prefix tokens in set A) + (current token in set B) - position, so a boolean predicate captures it only partially (dev F1 ~0.55, mass recall ~0.68); misses are weaker activations with other prefixes or tokens (e.g. v, w, k after f/i/e prefixes) and false positives are B tokens whose prefix is only weakly favourable.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=j (+7.13), orig0=f (+6.87), orig0=g (+6.52), orig0=u (+6.25), orig0=r (+6.12), orig0=0 (+5.50). Lower it: prev2_tok=c (-5.51), prev2_tok=2 (-5.28), prev2_tok=- (-4.88), prev2_tok=l (-4.88).
